text:
Situation: Tobramycin 300 mg/4 mL and 300 mg/5 mL ampules are in limited supply at both Corvale sites. Corvale East has 539 eaches of the 4 mL presentation (35 days on hand at 15.4/day) and 354 eaches of the 5 mL presentation (24.5 days at 14.4/day). Corvale General has 257 eaches of the 4 mL presentation (15.6 days at 16.5/day) and 293 eaches of the 5 mL presentation (18.3 days at 16/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show tobramycin is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 15 to 35 days depending on site and presentation. No FDA shortage listing exists. The top-ranked purchasing option is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today. All ranked suppliers have labels that name no identifiable manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for both presentations; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as a backup source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Ascend Laboratories LLC, and Aurobindo Pharma Limited for future allocation; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to monitor daily burn rates at both sites and report if any presentation falls below 14 days on hand; requires pharmacy director approval.
5. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be stabilized within 30 days; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Initiating conservation protocols or formulary changes at this time.
